title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Neelambari
desc: Vinod and his TV channel crew arrive in a village for a crucial assignment. A series of spooky events is set in motion after they interview a mysterious woman who lives there.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.
